graphkit fits the normaliser per network on that network's own tables, including label columns (Qg, slack p_mw); identical convention for released and every arm, also at evaluation
graphkit hides the REF |V| setpoint under the PF mask, as in every released-GENCO number in the post
B (continued pretraining on 7 corrected subgrids) already eroded held-out accuracy (preliminary, unaudited), so continued pretraining itself is a risk the D control measures
